svg.title: Hungary’s electric-car fleet and green-plate parking
svg.desc: EU Observatory annual BEV and PHEV fleet counts indexed to 2015=100, from 2008 through 2025, for Hungary and five neighboring countries. Budapest’s green-plate free-parking policy is marked at 2016. This comparison does not estimate the policy’s causal effect.
svg.text: Hungary’s EV fleet after green-plate parking?
BEV + PHEV fleet, indexed to 2015 = 100 · Hungary and regional peers
Fleet growth is not evidence that parking benefits caused people to buy EVs.
Source: European Alternative Fuels Observatory. Index compares growth from each country's own 2015 fleet; 2026 partial data excluded.
